announcement.title: 🎁 Unboxing the Mystery v1.6.0
announcement.content:
Unboxing the Mystery v1.6.0 adds Open with key for characters holding the required item.

  • Enable it on Journals, Tiles, Doors, or Item Piles containers to open them without playing the puzzle.
  • Key unlocks skip preceding Tile roll checks and keep normal reveals, rewards, and success macros. Consume Key determines whether the item is removed after a successful unlock.
  • The option is off by default and supports individual puzzle modes. Mystery Chains and gacha are excluded.
